body.purpose: System sans, 14px/1.55 in the legacy console and 14px/1.6 in server-rendered pages; conversation text is 15px/1.65.

heading.purpose: Page and section titles; 22px/1.25 with tight tracking.

marketing-display.purpose: Oversized marketing hero wordmark only; not application prose.

marketing-display-min.purpose: Responsive minimum size for the marketing wordmark.

micro-label.purpose: Compact data labels, never decorative eyebrows.

metadata.purpose: Secondary interface metadata; 12px is the smallest metadata size.

mono.purpose: Measured values, code and timestamps only; prose never uses mono.

server-body.purpose: 14px/1.6 body text on the server-rendered dashboard pages.

shadows.name: sh-1
shadows.purpose: Panels, cards, tables — resting elevation with a top hairline.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (dur-fast 110ms, dur 160ms, dur-slow 260ms).

motion.name: hero-float
motion.purpose: First-run mascot presence; static under reduced motion or Reduce effects.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The emerald action for the main decision on a view; near-black ink, clear focus, short state transition.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary, #34d399); color: var(--color-primary-content, #052e21); border: 1px solid var(--color-primary, #34d399); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 16px; min-height: 32px; font: 600 14px/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 110ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), border-color 110ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent, #6ee7b7); border-color: var(--color-accent, #6ee7b7); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-secondary, #60a5fa); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A secondary action with a quiet hairline border and restrained hover state.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-base-content, #f0f4f9); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 16px; min-height: 32px; font: 600 14px/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 110ms, border-color 110ms, color 110ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.05); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.22); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-secondary, #60a5fa); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A compact field on a sunken surface with a visible azure focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #9daebf; font: 500 12px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; background: #05070a; color: #f0f4f9; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 14px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #60a5fa; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: State is shown as a small dot and a readable word; colour never carries meaning alone.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); border-radius: 100px; color: #9daebf; background: transparent; font: 600 11px/1.2 ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-chip i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fbbf24; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: User Message
components.description: Right-aligned slate bubble with a small tail corner; agent replies remain plain text.
components.html: Sort this week’s downloads into folders.
components.css: .ds-bubble-user { max-width: min(560px, 88%); margin-left: auto; padding: 9px 14px; color: #f0f4f9; background: #1d2735; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); border-radius: 18px 18px 6px 18px; font: 400 15px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

components.name: Bot Roster Row
components.description: A compact bot identity row pairs the name and status with a restrained active surface.
components.css: .ds-roster { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0,1fr); align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 12px; color: #9daebf; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-roster:hover, .ds-roster[aria-current="true"] { background: rgba(52,211,153,.09); color: #f0f4f9; } .ds-roster:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-roster > span:last-child { display: grid; min-width: 0; } .ds-roster b { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; font-size: 14px; } .ds-roster small { color: #7d8ea4; font: 400 11px/1.4 ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-avatar { width: 30px; height: 30px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #34d399; color: #052e21; font: 700 12px/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }

narrative.northStar: An instrument that never lies, and never shouts.
narrative.overview: Hutch is a local-first multi-bot agent workspace: an operator console where a person sends tasks to bots, watches real execution, and decides consequential approvals. The design job is trust under time pressure — every pixel either helps someone understand what the machine is actually doing, or it is chrome that should shrink.
keyCharacteristics: Layered graphite surfaces with elevation by offset+blur shadow and a top hairline — never glow.
One conversation column (760px) carries the story; operational ledgers (runs, usage, approvals) support it as tables, not as the homepage.
Colour does jobs: emerald is the brand and the primary action; azure is interaction only; amber means a human must act now; rose means failure. Everything else is neutral so those four stay legible.
Mono type is reserved for measured values (ids, durations, counts, budgets) — it signals "this number came from the machine".
The 3D mascot (one sprite set shared with the marketing site) appears only in first-run/welcome moments; per-bot identity is the lightweight sigil.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Reading text caps at ~72ch; anything wider is layout debt.

rules.name: The One-Ink Rule
rules.body: Emerald fills always carry near-black ink (#052e21); white on emerald is forbidden (≈2.5:1).

rules.name: The Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only where a person must act now — pending approvals, expiring deadlines under two minutes, the attention nav badge. Never as decoration, never on "done" or "failed".

rules.name: The Scale Rule
rules.body: Every corner radius comes from `rounded.*`; no ad-hoc values.

rules.name: The Measured Rule
rules.body: Mono type is only for values the server measured — never for prose, labels, or marketing.

dos: Take every radius from `rounded.*`; keep the pill only for chips.
Pair every icon with a word for state; give every control a visible focus ring.
Use mono only for machine-measured values.
Show real server state: if the API cannot confirm it, say "unknown".
Keep motion short and functional; honor reduced motion and the Reduce effects override. Status dots stay steady; text carries the current state.
donts: Never put white on emerald, or amber on something that isn't person-needed.
Never box tool calls, or wrap decided approvals in cards.
Never run ambient loops, pulsing dots on idle state, or animated backgrounds behind work.
Never show a count, status or receipt the server did not produce.
Never add a radius outside the scale, or a colour outside the palette.
